entrypoints.summary: The MsgPack LibFuzzer entrypoint accepts a byte buffer and size and passes them directly to deserializeMsgPack.

affected_components.role: MessagePack length decoding and raw-string storage reservation

code_slices.fixed: The patch parses into uint32_t, rejects narrowed conversion, checks totalSize < n before reserve, and checks StringNode allocation size for overflow.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The fixed parser exposes deserializeMsgPack, and the fuzz target invokes it with fuzzer-provided data and size.
code_slices.vulnerable: The patch shows the pre-fix raw-string reservation as stringBuffer_.reserve(headerSize + n) and pre-fix multi-byte length accumulation into size.

observability.channel: sanitizer crash classification and deserialization error result
negative_controls: The fixed regression expects DeserializationError::NoMemory for maximal binary lengths.
The fixed maximal string-length regression expects a result other than Ok.
observability.positive_marker: The OSV record reports Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 1 in MsgPackDeserializer.

preconditions: A caller processes attacker-influenced MessagePack bytes using the affected ArduinoJson MessagePack deserializer.

impact.affected_asset: Heap memory used during MessagePack deserialization.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the parser to reach an out-of-bounds write condition through crafted MessagePack length fields.
impact.security_effect: Sanitizer-classified heap buffer overflow write of one byte.

causal_trace.summary: A supplied MessagePack byte sequence can encode maximal multi-byte binary or string lengths; the patch regression includes 0xFFFF and 0xFFFFFFFF length encodings.

Before the fix, parsed length accumulation and header-size-plus-payload sizing could produce a size value that did not faithfully represent the encoded length or required raw-string reservation; the fix rejects a narrowing conversion when size is below size32 and a wrapped total when totalSize is below n.
The affected raw-string path reserved string-buffer storage using headerSize + n; the repaired path checks the computed total before calling stringBuffer_.reserve(totalSize).
The OSV case record reports a Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 1 and identifies MsgPackDeserializer in its crash state.

failure.operation: Reserve raw-string buffer using a total derived from headerSize plus attacker-derived payload length.

primary_invariant.statement: The parsed MessagePack payload length and the header-plus-payload reservation size must be representable without wrap and must describe the storage required by the payload.
primary_invariant.violated_because: A multi-byte encoded length could cross size-width conversion and addition into the raw-string reservation path without detecting a narrowed or wrapped result.

quality.review_notes: The public OSV record establishes the sanitizer crash classification and affected commit range; the public maintainer patch supplies concrete arithmetic checks and testcase-linked regression literals. The original OSS-Fuzz issue is sign-in-gated, the original minimized corpus and complete sanitizer stack are absent, and no artifact records a test execution result. The reported heap overflow does not establish controllable write extent or code execution.

remediation.invariant_restored: Reject MessagePack lengths whose conversion or header-plus-payload total wraps before reserving storage, and reject wrapped StringNode allocation sizes.

oss_fuzz.sanitizer: not specified in supplied case record

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Supply a MessagePack binary or string header carrying a maximal encoded length through the byte-buffer deserialization entrypoint.
data_structure_invariants: Decoded payload length must be representable as size_t.
headerSize plus decoded payload length must not wrap before buffer reservation.
StringNode allocation size must not wrap below its requested string length.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The regression literals demonstrate binary and string MessagePack headers encoding these maximal values.
numeric_domains.name: encoded MessagePack length

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: It is computed from headerSize plus attacker-derived n and must not be less than n.
numeric_domains.name: reservation total

state_context.state_machine: MessagePack type dispatch selects string or binary length decoding, then raw-string storage reservation and parsing.

oracle.expected_negative: The boundary inputs must not be accepted as successful deserializations.
oracle.expected_positive: For maximal binary-length encodings in the added regression sections, deserializeMsgPack returns DeserializationError::NoMemory; the maximal string-length case returns a non-Ok error.
